paragraphs: R' Yehoshua ben Petar Rosh, a Tanna; [Nazir 56b](https://www.sefaria.org/Nazir.56b.9).[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked baraita names Rabbi Yehoshua ben Petar Rosh discussing the law with Rabbi Meir. [Heilprin’s Petar Rosh entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3017&lang=en) identifies Petar Rosh as his father.
Petar Rosh is a conventional vocalization of פתר ראש without etymological interpretation. Hyman supplies ben and the Tanna classification; the abbreviated title remains R'.
